```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build production
        run: npm run build
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production

      - name: Validate build outputs
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "dist/wplace-autobot.user.js" ]; then
            echo "❌ Build failed: Missing user script"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ ! -f "dist/wplace-autobot.bookmarklet.js" ]; then
            echo "❌ Build failed: Missing bookmarklet"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✅ Build validation passed"

      - name: Get current date for versioning
        id: date
        run: echo "date=$(date +'%Y.%m.%d-%H%M%S')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create release tag
        id: create_tag
        run: |
          TAG="v${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}"
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Created tag: $TAG"

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.create_tag.outputs.tag }}
          release_name: Release ${{ steps.create_tag.outputs.tag }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload user script
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./dist/wplace-autobot.user.js
          asset_name: wplace-autobot.user.js
          asset_content_type: application/javascript

      - name: Upload bookmarklet
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./dist/wplace-autobot.bookmarklet.js
          asset_name: wplace-autobot.bookmarklet.js
          asset_content_type: application/javascript

      - name: Upload manifest
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./dist/manifest.json
          asset_name: manifest.json
          asset_content_type: application/json

      - name: Final status
        run: |
          echo "🚀 Release ${{ steps.create_tag.outputs.tag }} created successfully!"
          echo "🔗 Stable download URL: https://github.com/Wplace-AutoBot/WPlace-AutoBOT/releases/latest/download/wplace-autobot.user.js"
```
